name: edge-calibration-template
notes: Template, not a run config: no edge-calibration walk is approved yet (ADR-0311 stage 5 and the 2019Q4-seeded run need the owner). Replace every PLACEHOLDER (the pinned MIO run document and its sha256, one forecasts/contexts sha256 pair per decision quarter, a NEW out_dir outside every input root) and nothing else changes the arithmetic. Use from Python: IndexOptionsEdgeWalk('edge', params).run(ctx, {}). The window ends 2021-06-30 and sealed_from is 2021-07-01 (the development seal): decisions 2019Q4 (a seed: state only, the HPO tuning year, A0008) and reported 2020Q1-2021Q2; a row settling on or after sealed_from is neither admitted nor scored, and nothing from 2024 on is ever read (A0003). RE-ENTRY Do-not list: forecasts, scores and calibrated edges are consumed in code only, agents report counts and hashes.

edge.notes: mio_document is the pinned MIO run document (its domain gives the study params, pairs, history_start and source pins; the quote filter values, multiplier and fee are READ from it, never restated here). forecast_pins must equal, per quarter, the sha256 pair among the document's forecast source pins (forecast_not_pinned otherwise). side_rule best keeps the larger-e side of each option. study_scope window builds one study; quarter builds one per decision quarter with identical output (the memory lever of stage 5). direction_regressor true needs the direction block (DirectionEdge: rate must be 0.0, multiplier must equal the study's; iv_source mid because the archive carries no vendor iv). buckets, regime, pooling and name_adjust are ADR-0311's B-1..B-4 defaults; edges are fixed numbers, never quantiles. edge_scale notional (spot x multiplier) is A-6(a); row_weight group_equal is A-7(a). out_dir must be new and outside the document's directory and every pin root.
